items.title: the "make a lot of money" trend
items.creator: @claireblxnco
items.body: set to "Housewife" again (this song is EVERYWHERE): people explain why they picked their job, or what they'd do if they suddenly got rich. the answers are so specific.

items.title: the "loading" getting-ready transition
items.creator: @araacelinero
items.body: people turn their getting-ready routine into one big before-and-after, timed to an original sound by saff. hair, lashes, the works. very satisfying.

items.title: "answer in one word"
items.body: people ask ChatGPT, their friends or their parents something personal and they can only answer in ONE word. the bluntness is the whole point.

items.title: the shaving cream prank fake-out
items.creator: @lifeasfive
items.body: a parent acts like they're going to help their kid pull a shaving cream prank, then bails at the very last second. the kid's face every time!!

items.title: gen alpha is going offline (kind of)
items.body: a GWI survey of 20K+ kids found physical toys on 8-15 year olds' wishlists are up 16% since 2023, and board games are up too. the kids want real stuff??

items.title: movie theaters are cool again
items.body: 28% of 8-15 year olds say the cinema is their favorite way to watch a movie. that's their #1 pick over streaming!!

items.title: "stealth scrolling"
items.body: only 1 in 10 kids ages 12-15 post everything they do, and just 2 in 5 feel like they can say what they really think online. they're mostly watching, not posting.

items.title: gen alpha girls think they can do any job
items.body: 54% of gen alpha girls believe they can do any job, vs 37% of boys. love that for them.
